Question: Which genre shows the **largest absolute improvement** in F1 score on the failure set after applying GBI for **both** syntactic parsing and SRL?
Evidence:
[E1] (table, Table 5, page 7): Table 5: Evaluation of syntactic parser and SRL system on out-of-domain data. F1 scores are reported on the failure set . SRL model was trained on NW and the syntactic parser was trained on WSJ Section on OntoNote v5.0. Except PT, which is new and old Testament, all failure rate on out-domain data is higher than that of in-domain (11.9% for parsing and 18.1% for SRL) as suspected. The table shows that GBI can be successfully applied to resolve performance degradation on out-of-domain data.
Values (cite as cells):
  row 'Genre': '' = Failure; 'Syntactic' = Conversion; 'Parsing' = F1 on; '' = failure set; '' = Failure; '' = Conversion; 'SRL' = F1; '' = on failure set
  row '': '' = rate (%); 'Syntactic' = rate (%); 'Parsing' = before; '' = after; '' = rate (%); '' = rate (%); 'SRL' = before; '' = after
  row 'Broadcast Conversation (BC)': '' = 19.3; 'Syntactic' = 98.8; 'Parsing' = 56.4; '' = 59.0 (+2.6); '' = 26.86; '' = 53.88; 'SRL' = 39.72; '' = 52.4 (+12.68)
  row 'Broadcast News (BN)': '' = 11.7; 'Syntactic' = 98.1; 'Parsing' = 63.2; '' = 68.8 (+5.6); '' = 18.51; '' = 55.19; 'SRL' = 39.28; '' = 50.58 (+11.3)
  row 'Pivot Corpus (PT)': '' = 9.8; 'Syntactic' = 97.8; 'Parsing' = 71.4; '' = 75.8 (+4.4); '' = 10.01; '' = 62.34; 'SRL' = 47.19; '' = 63.69 (+16.5)
  row 'Telephone Conversation (TC)': '' = 10.1; 'Syntactic' = 86.2; 'Parsing' = 56.9; '' = 57.6. (+0.7); '' = 19.09; '' = 54.62; 'SRL' = 47.7; '' = 58.04 (+10.34)
  row 'Weblogs (WB)': '' = 17.6; 'Syntactic' = 95.3; 'Parsing' = 62.0; '' = 63.2 (+1.2); '' = 20.32; '' = 44.13; 'SRL' = 47.6; '' = 57.39 (+9.39)

These claims failed the checks; write corrected claims to replace them:
- "For Pivot Corpus (PT), the syntactic parsing F1 on failure set changes from 71.4 to 75.8 (+4.4), and the SRL F1 on failure set changes from 47.19 to 63.69 (+16.5).": E1 Pivot Corpus (PT)/ is Pivot Corpus (PT), the claim says 75.8 (+4.4)
- "Pivot Corpus (PT) shows the largest absolute improvement in F1 score on the failure set for both syntactic parsing and SRL.": support check: While Pivot Corpus (PT) has the largest absolute improvement in F1 for SRL (+16.5), it does not have the largest absolute improvement for syntactic parsing (+4.4, compared to Broadcast News with +5.6).

claims.text: The genre Broadcast News (BN) shows the largest absolute improvement in syntactic parsing F1 on the failure set (+5.6).
The genre Pivot Corpus (PT) shows the largest absolute improvement in SRL F1 on the failure set (+16.5).
No single genre shows the largest absolute improvement in F1 score on the failure set for both syntactic parsing and SRL simultaneously.
